channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: DOJ widens beef price probe to eight retailers, including Walmart and Amazon, as inflation looms over midterms
item.description: The expanded retailer probe appears to build on the department's antitrust investigation into meatpackers.

item.title: Argentina's Milei threatens sanctions on Falklands oil firms, citing Trump's possible stance shift
item.description: Argentina's president argues oil development would entrench Britain's presence, raising the economic stakes of the long-standing territorial dispute.

item.title: Cyclospora outbreaks highlight crumbling U.S. food safety system, worsened by DOGE cuts
item.description: A food safety expert says DOGE's personnel and research cuts are the opposite of efficiency, likely making outbreaks worse.

item.title: Top sovereign wealth fund may sell $80 billion in Treasury bonds and shift to riskier U.S. debt
item.description: The fund's overall dollar-denominated exposure would stay nearly steady at 52.5%, compared with 52.9% currently.
